cues.en: Let's now create a service that will allow the authenticated user to delete a next of kin.
cues.zh: 現在建立服務，讓已驗證的使用者刪除一位近親。

cues.en: So you're going to open the next of kin.py file within backend app API services.
cues.zh: 開啟 backend/app/api/services 裡的 next_of_kin.py。

cues.en: Then at the bottom right there after the update next of kin method we can say async define delete underscore next of kin.
cues.zh: 在下面 update_next_of_kin 方法後面，定義 async def delete_next_of_kin。

cues.en: This function is going to take in the user id of type uuid.
Then the next of kin id that's going to be of type Uuid.
Then the session that's going to be async session.
Then the function is going to return a dictionary with the key of string and a value of string like that.
cues.zh: 函式回傳鍵與值都為 str 的字典。

cues.en: Then as usual, we have our try block.
cues.zh: 一樣建立 try 區塊。

cues.en: Within the try block, we're going to use the get next of kin count function to check if there's only one next of kin.
cues.zh: 使用 get_next_of_kin_count 檢查是否只剩一位近親。

cues.en: So you can see total count, just like we did before.
We can say await, get next of kin count taking in the user ID and the session.
cues.zh: await get_next_of_kin_count，傳入 user_id 與 session。

cues.en: Then if there's only one, we're going to raise an HTTP exception.
cues.zh: 若只剩一位，就拋出 HTTPException。

cues.en: As you can see, if total count is less than or equals to one, then we can raise an HTTP exception with the status code being a status dot http of 100 badrequest.
cues.zh: 若 total_count 小於或等於 1，拋出 HTTPException，狀態碼為 status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST。

cues.en: Then the detail that's going to be a status that will be error.
cues.zh: detail 中的 status 為 error。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a message and that's going to be cannot delete the only next of kin.
cues.zh: message 為「不能刪除唯一的近親」。

cues.en: Then the action that's going to be at least one next of kin must be maintained.
cues.zh: action 為「必須保留至少一位近親」。

cues.en: Then after that we can now get the next of kin.
As you can see, next of kin.
That's going to be a wait.
Get user next of kin.
Then we're going to pass in the user ID and then the next of kin ID and then the session.
Then we can now delete the next of kin.
cues.zh: 接著就能刪除這位近親。

cues.en: So you can say await session dot delete.
And you're going to pass in the next of kin.
Then we can commit to the database by saying await session dot commit.
cues.zh: 再 await session.commit()，提交至資料庫。

cues.en: Then we can log this by saying logger.info.
And in f strings we can say next of kin deleted.
cues.zh: 用 f-string 寫「近親資料已刪除」。

cues.en: Then get pass in the next of kin id for the user.
cues.zh: 再帶入 next_of_kin_id，接著「所屬使用者」。

cues.en: Then we pass in the user id then we can return a success message.
cues.zh: 帶入 user_id，再回傳成功訊息。

cues.en: So you're going to say return the key of status.
That's going to be a success.
Then the message that can be next of kin deleted successfully.
cues.zh: message 可以是「近親資料刪除成功」。

cues.en: Then in case of any exceptions.

cues.zh: 可以複製上一個函式的 except 區塊。

Make sure you get the indentation correct.

Then within this exception we're going to change the error log.
cues.zh: 其他例外這裡修改錯誤日誌。
